saw_lines: Golfers pick used balls by brand and condition, then reorder the same grade once one plays well.
So the sale is won or lost in the first line, where buyers decide if a used ball is safe.
Your site shows 84,617 reviews, yet only 1 of 30 ads carries a site proof number, so put the review count on the creative and open the first line with it.

ads.source: Meta Ad Library, active ads, 1 Nov 2026
points: Your site shows 84,617 reviews, yet only 1 of 30 ads carries a site proof number. Strangers buying used balls need review proof before they click. Put the review count on the creative and open the first line with it.

None of your 30 ads mention shipping, though your site lists free shipping over $89 for US orders. A new buyer wondering about delivery has no reason to click. Open the copy for new buyers with the free shipping line.

None of your 30 ads is video. Golfers want to see condition before they trust a used ball, and a still feed image cannot show it. Shoot three videos of balls in play, then test them against your best image ad.

21 of your 30 ads are catalog feed with no story, so each shows a product and price only. Buyers scrolling past a bucket of balls get no reason to stop. Add three story ads about losing balls on the course.

ads_1: Story ads opening on review proof and free shipping, filmed as short videos
soc_1: Brand social strategy across Facebook, Instagram, Pinterest, TikTok, Twitter and YouTube
